title: fix(objectql)!: store an object's own actions as their ActionSchema parse, so a raw manifest's requiresFeature is lowered
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X2VRuXMiLAGHgLpSEE4E55n)_

Fixes #25744

Clause-②: no (narrowing: an object's own action that fails `ActionSchema` is refused at the runtime registration door, as #25649 did for standalone actions)
Metadata-protocol: none

**BREAKING** for a package that registers an object whose own action `ActionSchema` does not accept. Such an object used to be stored as written, with the action's declared gates inert. Now the object's registration is refused with `INVALID_METADATA` (422) and nothing of it is stored. The error names the action, its object and its package, and `issues[]` locates each failure as `actions.N.KEY`. An object that passes `os validate` or a strict `defineStack` is unaffected. ADR-0087 disposition (in the changeset): `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. `ActionSchema` and `ObjectSchema` are byte-unchanged, so there is nothing for `objectstack migrate meta` to rewrite.

## What changed

`SchemaRegistry.registerObject` (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`) now stores a code package's object with its own `actions` as their `ActionSchema` parse. If an action does not parse, the registry refuses the object loudly. Before, the actions were stored as the package wrote them.

- **One parse path.** The object path reuses the helper PR #25699 added for a standalone `action` item, `parsePackageAction`. It gains an optional `owner` (`{ object, index }`), so an object action's refusal names its object and prefixes each issue path with `actions.N`. A new `parsePackageObjectActions` maps it over the object's `actions` and returns a shallow copy; the caller's body is never mutated.
- **Where in the method.** Right after the field-`type` door and the two `extend` refusals, and before any materialization or the contributor list. So a refused object leaves nothing behind, and a refused re-registration leaves the object already registered under that package in place (pinned).
- **Which registrations.** The test is `registerItem`'s action-parse test (`packageId` passed and `isCodeArtifactBody`), asked of the body as `applyProtection` will stamp it later in the method: the package id it does not already carry, and `'package'` provenance. A registration with no `packageId`, the `sys_metadata` sentinel, and a tenant-authored body (`_provenance: 'org'`: the save door's write-through and the boot rehydration) are not judged here.
- **Idempotent over parsed input.** `ObjectSchema`'s `actions` is `ActionSchema[]`, so a platform object (`ObjectSchema.create`) and a strict `defineStack` already hand this method parsed actions, and they are stored deep-equal to what arrived (pinned as the control).
- **Refusal envelope.** `INVALID_METADATA` / 422 (ADR-0112), the code this package already uses for metadata that fails the spec. No new error code.

## Producers measured

Measured at `9ca36b163e` with every in-repo producer of an object with `actions`: each object's actions run through `ActionSchema.safeParse` and compared as canonical (key-sorted) JSON. Sources: every non-test file under `packages/**/src` that declares an `actions: [` array (connectors, platform objects, plugin-approvals, service-automation, qa fixtures, verify), the four example stacks (`app-crm`, `app-todo`, `app-showcase`, `app-multi-package`) and `platform-objects`' entry.

- 21 objects carrying actions, 154 actions. Refused: 4, all on one object. Changed by the parse: 0.
- The 4 refused are the `account` object of the published test fixture `FLS_CONTRACT_OBJECT` (`@objectstack/metadata-core/testing`): its `script` actions carry no `body` or `target`. Its own CHANGELOG already records it as not a spec-valid object. No suite registers it through `registerObject` (its readers in `packages/rest` and `packages/metadata-core` serve it from a stored map), so this door never meets it. It is left unchanged and named in the acceptance notes.
- No shipped product object fails the parse.

### Fixture triage (the refusal's consumer radius)

Two runtime fixtures registered an object action body `ActionSchema` refuses. Each got the missing declaration; nothing pinned the removed behaviour:

- `runtime/src/stored-metadata-reader-contexts.pin.test.ts`: the four host-handler `script` actions on `pin_note` name their `target`. Dispatch is by handler key, so the pins' subject is unchanged (171 tests in the two files green).
- `runtime/src/domains/mcp-package-object-discovery.test.ts`: the AI-exposed `ping` action's `description` is 40 characters or more, the length `ActionSchema` requires.

## Tests

New, `packages/objectql/src/object-own-action-schema-parse.test.ts`, through the real `ObjectQL.registerApp` / `registry.registerObject` and `protocol.getMetaItem({ type: 'object' })`, the read behind `GET /api/v1/meta/objects/:name`:

- A raw manifest's object action with `requiresFeature` and a CEL `visible` is served with the conjunct lowered, with no `requiresFeature` key, equal to what `ObjectSchema.create` gives the same declaration.
- With no `visible`, the gate alone. `requiresMembershipReach` is lowered the same way.
- A `strict: false` `defineStack` hands the body on raw; registered, it is served lowered.
- A direct `registerObject` under a package is parsed, and the caller's body is not mutated.
- Control: an object `ObjectSchema.create` produced is served deep-equal to it.
- Refusal: `requiresFeature` beside `visible: false` is refused `INVALID_METADATA` / 422; the message names `gated`, `oa_org` and `com.test.raw`; `issues[]` holds `actions.0.requiresFeature`; nothing is registered.
- A refused re-registration (an undeclared key, `unrecognized_keys`) leaves the registered object in place.

**Red first.** With `registry.ts` restored to the base blob, the new file ran 7 failed / 1 passed; the one green was the control.

**Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`). The test imports `./registry.js` from source, so no dist leg applies. The anchor `schema = parsePackageObjectActions(schema, packageId);` hit once and was replaced by a comment; blob `ca946b02a9` to `b5fb1f4f77`. Result: 7 failed, 1 passed (the control). Restore: blob `ca946b02a9` equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Local verification

Head `cf6bf094b9`.

- **Dogfood battery, full**, under the verify lock with CI's command (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, no `OS_TEST_SHARD`, no paths), after building the `@objectstack/dogfood^...` closure: `Test Files 296 passed | 3 skipped (299)`, `Tests 2523 passed | 18 skipped (2541)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. Run at `3867ab77`; the only later commit edits two runtime test fixtures.
- `@objectstack/objectql` full: `Test Files 470 passed (470)`, `Tests 8738 passed (8738)`. Typecheck exit 0, `check:test-typecheck: OK`.
- `@objectstack/runtime` full: `Test Files 446 passed (446)`, `Tests 7131 passed | 19 skipped`. Typecheck exit 0, `check:test-typecheck: OK`.
- `@objectstack/rest` full: `Test Files 322 passed (322)`, `Tests 6466 passed | 326 skipped`.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` full: `Test Files 264 passed | 3 skipped (267)`, `Tests 21518 passed | 19 skipped`.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the touched `objectql` files: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on this diff derives 73 families; all run, `--ran`: 73 derived, 73 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.

## Acceptance notes

- **Boundary kept: tenant overlay rows.** A tenant-authored object body (`_provenance: 'org'`) is not parsed at this door. It is the save door's to parse, and the overlay row of a packaged action is outside this card.
- **A non-array `actions`.** Only an `actions` array is parsed. A body whose `actions` is not an array is left as it was; `ObjectSchema` refuses that shape at the authoring doors.
- **`FLS_CONTRACT_OBJECT` stays off-contract.** Its four `script` actions carry no `body` or `target` (measured above). This door never registers it today; a suite that registers it under a package would now be refused.
- **Doubled period in the refusal text.** `parsePackageAction` joins each issue's message and then adds a period, so a Zod message that ends in one reads `…function name)..`. The standalone-action refusal already prints this on `main`; this PR does not change the sentence.
